# Legacy Music Group

Legacy Music Group is an engineer-led recording and production studio in Deep Ellum, Dallas.

## Verified contact

- Address: 2815 Main St, Suite A, Dallas, TX 75226
- Phone: +1 214 377 9729
- Email: info@legacymusicgroup.com
- Hours: open daily, 10am to 1am
- Website: https://legacy-music-group.netlify.app/

## Core services and published starting rates

- Recording with an engineer: from $75 per hour
- Room-only recording: from $45 per hour
- Mixing and mastering: from $150 per song
- Artist development: available by consultation

Rates are starting estimates. The studio confirms availability, deposit requirements and final project scope directly.

## Studio team

- Matthew Medlock: studio owner and manager
- Ray Dallas: head engineer
- Wayne: studio engineer and producer
- Terry: maintenance engineer

## Third-party coverage

- D Magazine included Legacy Music Group in its July 2026 feature on influential Dallas recording artists: https://www.dmagazine.com/publications/d-magazine/2026/july/the-25-most-influential-dallas-recording-artists-of-the-last-25-years/
- Dallas Observer profiled owner Matthew Medlock and the Deep Ellum studio: https://www.dallasobserver.com/music/deep-ellums-matthew-medlock-is-undeterred-by-shooting-at-his-recording-studio-8278683/

## Booking

The live calendar connection is being completed. Call or email the studio with a preferred date, session length and engineer. The studio team will confirm current availability.
